prompt: The program crashes when run. Make it print 'hello world' and exit cleanly without panicking.
setup:
cat > go.mod <<'EOF'
module benchtest

go 1.21
EOF
cat > main.go <<'EOF'
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("hello world")
	panic("boom")
}
EOF
verify: out=$(go run . 2>&1); echo "$out" | grep -q "hello world" && ! echo "$out" | grep -qi panic

prompt: The test suite fails. Reproduce the failure, fix the bug in Add, and make the tests pass.
setup:
cat > go.mod <<'EOF'
module benchtest

go 1.21
EOF
cat > main.go <<'EOF'
package main

func Add(a, b int) int { return a - b }
EOF
cat > main_test.go <<'EOF'
package main

import "testing"

func TestAdd(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Add(2, 3); got != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("Add(2,3) = %d, want 5", got)
	}
}
EOF
